memories.content: The user completed a routine dental checkup in April 2024.
When the user heard three checkup questions in succession, they asked for the first question again.
At the next visit, when questions were asked one at a time, the user answered each without omission.
The user called to reschedule an appointment at lunchtime but did not reach anyone.
After returning home, the user kept a photo of the paper instructions received at the clinic.
On a day the user put only the visit address in the calendar, they had to search again for the floor.
On a day the user shared the checkup time with their older sister, the sister called to check in after the user returned home.
The scheduling staff at that clinic expect requests to change appointments to arrive by telephone.
Before adding a follow-up visit to the calendar, confirm the date, time, address, and floor with the user.
The local agent can track completed checkups and scheduled appointments but cannot determine whether a follow-up visit is needed.
The user keeps gloves and scarves in a basket inside the entrance.
On a day the user could not find their gloves, they walked with their hands in their pockets and missed the bus.
Before the next outing, the user put the gloves in the entrance basket the night before and left on time.
On a snowy day, the user chose a shorter route but turned back at stairs that had not been cleared of snow.
The next day, the user took a cleared sidewalk along the main road and avoided slippery sections.
The user fell asleep with the heat turned up, became too warm before dawn, and woke twice.
The next night, the user turned down the heat and used one additional thin blanket.
On a morning with heavy snow, the user's father expects the user will worry about road conditions and sends a text before departure.
Before proposing a winter travel route, check recent snow-clearing conditions and accessible entrances.
The local agent cannot know the actual condition of the sidewalk the user will take from a weather forecast alone.

analysis.overview: The frames contain independently useful information in separate domains. The reference frame concerns dental visits, communication, scheduling, records, family check-ins, and agent limits; the compared frame concerns winter clothing, routes, home temperature, family support, and travel-condition limits. No scope-aligned claims overlap materially.

relations.reason: This dental-care history is independently useful and has no materially corresponding claim in the compared frame.
relations.summary: The user completed a routine dental checkup in April 2024.

relations.reason: These observations jointly describe the effect of question pacing during visits, which the compared frame does not address.
relations.summary: The user needed repetition after several consecutive checkup questions but answered fully when questions were presented individually.

relations.reason: These memories jointly describe the clinic’s telephone rescheduling channel and an observed access failure, with no counterpart in the compared frame.
relations.summary: Appointment-change requests at the clinic are expected by telephone, and a lunchtime rescheduling call went unanswered.

relations.reason: This record-retention fact is independently useful and absent from the compared frame.
relations.summary: The user retained a photograph of the clinic’s paper instructions after returning home.

relations.reason: The memories jointly support complete dental-visit calendar details, an operational concern not covered by the compared frame.
relations.summary: Follow-up calendar entries should be confirmed with the user for date, time, address, and floor because an address-only entry previously required another floor search.

relations.reason: This dental-visit family-support observation is independently useful and has no same-context counterpart in the compared frame.
relations.summary: After receiving the checkup time, the user’s older sister called to check in following the visit.

relations.reason: This capability boundary is specific to dental follow-up decisions and is not addressed by the compared frame.
relations.summary: The local agent can track completed and scheduled dental visits but cannot determine whether follow-up care is needed.

relations.reason: This household storage convention is independently useful and has no materially corresponding claim in the reference frame.
relations.summary: The user stores gloves and scarves in a basket inside the entrance.

relations.reason: These observations jointly describe the departure effect of advance glove preparation, which the reference frame does not address.
relations.summary: Difficulty finding gloves contributed to a missed bus, while placing them in the entrance basket the night before supported an on-time departure.

relations.reason: These memories jointly describe evidence, policy, and an information limit for snow-route selection, with no corresponding claim in the reference frame.
relations.summary: Winter route selection depends on recent clearing and accessible entrances; observed cleared paths were usable, uncleared stairs were not, and forecasts alone cannot establish actual sidewalk conditions.

relations.reason: These memories jointly describe an overnight temperature problem and subsequent adjustment, which the reference frame does not address.
relations.summary: High overnight heat caused warmth and repeated waking, followed the next night by lower heat and one additional thin blanket.

relations.reason: This weather-linked family-support pattern is independently useful and has no same-context counterpart in the reference frame.
relations.summary: During heavy snow, the user’s father anticipates concern about road conditions and texts before departure.

reports.compared_only: The compared frame uniquely covers glove organization, winter-route accessibility, nighttime temperature adjustment, parental pre-departure support, and limits on inferring sidewalk conditions.
reports.reference_only: The reference uniquely records dental-care history, question pacing, telephone rescheduling, retained instructions, complete calendar details, sibling check-ins, and limits on determining follow-up needs.
